record.paper_title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems
record.original_question: Is a compact smooth Riemannian manifold secure if and only if it is flat?

evidence.quote: Гипотеза 3. Компактное гладкое риманово многообразие безопасно тогда и только тогда, когда оно плоское.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a compact smooth connected Riemannian manifold. For points $x,y \in M$, let $\Gamma(x,y)$ denote the set of all geodesic segments from $x$ to $y$ (parameterized by arclength, of any length). A finite set $B \subset M \setminus \{x,y\}$ is said to block $\Gamma(x,y)$ if every $\gamma \in \Gamma(x,y)$ passes through some point of $B$. The pair $(x,y)$ is called secure if $\Gamma(x,y)$ can be blocked by some finite set $B$, and the manifold $(M,g)$ is called secure if every pair of points $(x,y) \in M \times M$ is secure. The manifold is called flat if its sectional curvature is identically zero.

It is known that every compact flat Riemannian manifold is secure. Prove or disprove the following converse: a compact smooth Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ is secure if and only if $(M,g)$ is flat.
artifact.category_tag: Security and blocking on Riemannian manifolds
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that a compact Riemannian manifold is secure iff it is flat is widely believed and has been verified in several special cases. Burns and Gutkin (2008) proved that secure 2-dimensional tori are flat; Gerber and Lafont, and others, established total insecurity of closed surfaces of genus ≥ 2 with any metric and of genus-1 surfaces with generic metrics. The full conjecture in arbitrary dimension remains open.

status_evidence.title: Secure two-dimensional tori are flat
status_evidence.snippet: We prove that a Riemannian 2-torus is secure if and only if it is flat.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is solved in dimension 2 for tori (Burns–Gutkin).

status_evidence.title: Blocking light in compact Riemannian manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Compact flat manifolds are secure; conjecture that these are the only secure compact Riemannian manifolds; partial results for surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: General conjecture is open; partial results in low dimension and for surfaces of higher genus.
